I missed the early bus because the coffee shop had only one person working and the line curled around the door. By the time I reached the station my sleeve was wet from the rain and a man was arguing with the ticket machine. Nothing dramatic happened but the whole morning felt slightly out of step.

My grandmother kept buttons in an old blue tin that rattled whenever someone opened the sewing drawer. I used to sort them by color while she worked near the window. Some were chipped and some still had bits of thread attached. She never threw any of them away.
